_comment: Target scenarios and benchmarks per racecar id for scripts/schema-serde/optimization_experiment.sh (task 9.19). Lower is better for every metric. A candidate is kept only if every target metric that was measured improves by more than its null-experiment floor and no other measured metric (guard_metrics, every case) regresses by more than its floor. See README.md.

F.note: 9.20's fast path sits in DefaultAwsV4HttpSigner, above the internal V4RequestSigner that Sigv4SignerBenchmark calls, so the target is AwsV4HttpSignerBenchmark (the public signer, added in the candidate commit on opt/F) and Sigv4SignerBenchmark is a guard. Both arms' benchmarks.jar must contain AwsV4HttpSignerBenchmark: bring the benchmark class to the feature build before the measurement.

E6.note: Racecar measured -4 to -7% on its own writer; measured here against the ported JSON writer.

E7.note: Racecar measured -3.4% on batch-get; measured here against the ported JSON reader.

D1.note: Apache5 is the v2-sync client of the harness.

E12.note: CRT is the v2-async client of the harness.

E13.note: The copy runs on every call, not on an AuthSchemeResolutionCache miss: EndpointResolution calls AuthSchemeResolver.applyInterceptorModifiedProperties after every resolve (E13-smoke.md). Smithy-java 1f68318ce (skip the override merge when there are no overrides) maps to mergePreExistingAuthSchemeProperties; on the harness calls that merge must add the placeholder's null ChecksumAlgorithm, which the resolved option lacks, so it copies on every call and only E13 is measured (E13.md).
